facts.text: The hotel is at Calle de Hermosilla 2 in Madrid, next to Paseo de la Castellana and Calle Serrano.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by shops and businesses, next to Paseo de la Castellana or Calle Serrano

facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of Madrid's financial and commercial center.
facts.excerpt: located in the heart of the city's financial and commercial center

facts.text: The hotel is near El Prado, the National Archaeological Museum, the Reina Sofía and the Thyssen-Bornemisza.
facts.excerpt: its location near El Prado, the National Archaeological Museum (MAN), the Reina Sofía, or the Thyssen Bornemisza

facts.text: The hotel is part of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: has led it to become part of the 'The Leading Hotels of the World' group

facts.text: Aduana is the hotel's seventh-floor restaurant, with views over Plaza de Colón and the Salamanca district.
facts.excerpt: nestled on the seventh floor where breathtaking panoramic views embrace Colon Square and the refined Salamanca District

facts.text: Aduana serves Mediterranean fusion cuisine built around global spices.
facts.excerpt: A gastronomic adventure of mediterranean fusion meticulously curated with global spices and flavours.

facts.text: Aduana is named after the starting point of Columbus's voyage to the New World.
facts.excerpt: Aduana, named after the commencement point of Cristobal Colon

facts.text: Zuma serves Japanese cuisine with three experiences: contemporary dishes, a robata grill and a sushi bar.
facts.excerpt: Zuma serves Japanese cuisine and offers 3 different dining experiences: a delicious selection of contemporary dishes, a Robata grill and a sushi bar.

facts.text: Zuma has a terrace open all year round, heated in winter.
facts.excerpt: Heated in winter and decorated with lush plants

facts.text: Balmoral is the hotel's bar, serving cocktails, traditional tapas and Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Its daring mixology, traditional tapas and Mediterranean cuisine create unique experiences

facts.text: The Thai room wellness space is decorated with Burmese decor, Chinese ornaments and Tibetan artwork.
facts.excerpt: with the Burmese decor, Chinese ornaments and Tibetan artwork adorning this temple of relaxation

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: the latest Technogym equipment

facts.text: The hotel's dog program allows up to two dogs per room with no weight limit.
facts.excerpt: an exclusive program for dogs, with no weight limit and allowing up to 2 pets per room

facts.text: A complimentary Luxury Van takes guests around the city of Madrid.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our complimentary "Luxury Van" service to take you wherever you want in the city of Madrid.

facts.text: RedLevel guests have a private lounge, private reception and private breakfast service.
facts.excerpt:
Access to the private Lounge

Private reception area

Private breakfast service (à la carte and buffet)

facts.text: Several RedLevel suites have private terraces with hot tubs overlooking Plaza de Colón.
facts.excerpt: Soak away all your worries during a starlit hot-tub session on your private terrace and feast your eyes on the exclusive views of Plaza de Colón

facts.text: The hotel offers a private tour of Las Ventas bullring with a bullfighting expert, including the Bullfighting Museum.
facts.excerpt: Take a personalized tour of the Plaza de Toros de Las Ventas with a bullfighting expert

facts.text: The hotel arranges a flamenco master class and show at Corral de la Morería.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a master class and a show while savoring a delicious culinary proposal.

facts.text: Guests can tour the Seseña cape workshop with the founder's great-grandson.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a guided tour of the Seseña workshop

facts.text: Gran Meliá and Audi offer guests a day driving an electric Audi e-tron.
facts.excerpt: enjoy driving a new Audi e-tron for a day, a 100% electric model

facts.text: The Deluxe Room is a Neoclassical room with complete soundproofing.
facts.excerpt: This Neoclassical room has everything you need for ultimate relaxation: a queen-size bed, complete soundproofing

facts.text: The Family Grand Supreme room has an auxiliary bathroom with toiletries for delicate skin.
facts.excerpt: This room has an auxiliary bathroom with shower and complementary toiletries for delicate skin.

facts.text: The hotel is 13 km from the airport.
facts.excerpt: 13 km from Airport

facts.text: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is before 12:00.
facts.excerpt: Check-in can be made from 15:00 on the arrival day. Check-out must be made before 12:00 on the departure day.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself a flagship of Madrid's hospitality.
facts.excerpt: A flagship hotel of Madrid's hospitality
